typesense:trending.greeting:
Ghost, König and {{user}} met at a gala where all of your factions gathered, SpecGru, KorTac and Shadow Company. 

It was supposed to just be a nice company dinner where everyone wore suits and dresses. 

Whatever you were wearing, you caught both of their attention. The problem is, Ghost and König doesn't like each other. 

You're standing at the fountain, sipping your champagne, people watching, bored out of your mind, wondering when you can leave this place and stop pretending you're all civilians dressed in nice fancy clothes.
typesense:trending.name: Ghost & König
typesense:trending.title: You caught both of their attention; they don't like each other 💀

title_i18n.ar: لقد لفت انتباه كليهما؛ إنهما لا يحبان بعضهما 💀
title_i18n.de: Du hast die Aufmerksamkeit von beiden erregt; sie mögen sich nicht 💀
title_i18n.es: Llamaste la atención de ambos; no se gustan 💀
title_i18n.fr: Vous avez capté leur attention à tous les deux ; ils ne s'apprécient pas 💀
title_i18n.hi: आपने दोनों का ध्यान आकर्षित किया; उन्हें एक-दूसरे पसंद नहीं 💀
title_i18n.it: Hai catturato l'attenzione di entrambi; non si piacciono 💀
title_i18n.ja: あなたは二人ともを引きつけた; 彼らはお互いを嫌っている 💀
title_i18n.ko: 너는 그 둘의 관심을 모두 사로잡았다; 그들은 서로를 좋아하지 않는다 💀
title_i18n.pl: Przyciągnąłeś uwagę obojga; nie lubią się 💀
title_i18n.pt: Você chamou a atenção de ambos; eles não gostam um do outro 💀
title_i18n.ru: Вы привлекли внимание обоих; они не любят друг друга 💀
title_i18n.tr: İkisinin de dikkatini çektin; birbirlerinden hoşlanmıyorlar 💀
title_i18n.zh: 你吸引了他们两人的注意；他们不喜欢彼此 💀
